# aswArPot.sys ![:inline](/images/twitter_verified.png) 

### Description

Avast and AVG Anti Rootkit driver aswArPot.sys versions before 22.1 are affected by CVE-2022-26522 and CVE-2022-26523. Double-fetch races in kernel handlers allow a non-administrator user to corrupt kernel memory and execute code in kernel context, enabling local privilege escalation and security-product bypass.
- **UUID**: 57fc510a-e649-4599-b83e-8f3605e3d1d9
- **Created**: 2023-01-09
- **Author**: Michael Haag
- **Acknowledgement**:  | [@mattnotmax](https://twitter.com/@mattnotmax)

{{< blockbanner "aswArPot.sys" >}}
### Commands

```
sc.exe create aswArPot.sys binPath=C:\windows\temp\aswArPot.sys type=kernel &amp;&amp; sc.exe start aswArPot.sys
```


| Use Case | Privileges | Operating System | 
|:---- | ---- | ---- |
| Elevate privileges | kernel | Windows 10 |
